concept: TTFT Compute Bound Analysis and Inter-token Latency Jitter
summary: Source-anchored research for TTFT Compute Bound Analysis and Inter-token Latency Jitter. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Inter-token latency variance (jitter) is primarily induced by dynamic KV cache heap allocations and memory compaction pauses when context thresholds are crossed. (high confidence)
TTFT scales with prompt length in proportion to compute matrix FLOPs (O(N)), while sequential token generation scales purely with memory bandwidth per token (O(1)). (high confidence)
